summary: Embedding version header mismatch results in mixed-precision vectors and rerank ordering regression
description: Customer reports that after a dataset refresh, their reranking results have lower relevance and occasional NaN scores. Investigation shows that some documents were indexed with an older embedding variant header (X-Embed-Version: v1) while the reranker pipeline was expecting v2 vectors. The mismatch caused silent precision conversion to fall back to CPU float32 paths for some requests, increasing latency and producing slightly different normalization behavior that changed cosine rankings.
impact: Production rerank quality degradation for ~2.4% of traffic for NovatoHealth. Increased 95th percentile rerank latency from 85ms to 320ms for those mixed requests. Customer-facing search relevance complaints logged with support and product team. Potential compliance concern because some documents were reindexed with legacy variants without explicit tagging.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use an index created with X-Embed-Version: v1 vectors (legacy exporter).
2) Send a rerank request against redwood-reranker-v1 with pipeline configured for redwood-embed-v2 normalization semantics.
3) Observe percentile latency increase and differing top-k ordering compared to consistent-version index.
4) Check response for subtle NaN or -inf scores in rare cases when a mixed-precision conversion path fails silently.

2026-03-10T14:12:04Z [api-gateway] INFO: request_id=abc-123 latencies: embed_lookup=12ms, normalization=98ms, rerank=200ms
investigation_notes: Initial triage: confirms mismatch between embedded vector header and pipeline expectation. Customer reindex job introduced v1 vectors today during a partial update.
Hypothesis A: Legacy exporter wrote vectors with no explicit dtype tag; embeddings-service inferred float16 but flagged version header v1.
Hypothesis B: Normalization code path assumes v2 and triggers optimized GPU kernels; when fed v1 it falls back to CPU, causing both latency and numeric differences.
Load tests: replayed 10k mixed-version requests in staging; observed 3% of requests hit conversion edge-case with NaN score and elevated p95 latency similar to production.
Cross-reference: SUP-22134 has a vector-shape/compat issue; linked for context but root cause differs (metadata mismatch vs schema shape issue).
temporary_workarounds: 1) Customer action: re-run indexer with explicit --embed-version=v2 to normalize vector headers (recommended short-term).
2) Support action: added request-level validation that rejects index documents where X-Embed-Version header is absent or mismatched (temporary gate in front of reranker).
3) Operational: route NovatoHealth traffic to dedicated fallback pool that forces deterministic float32 conversion to reduce NaNs while investigation continues.
resolution: Engineering implemented a validation check in the embeddings-service that rejects writes/updates where X-Embed-Version does not match cluster policy and emits clear error to caller. Reranker code updated to perform a deterministic, GPU-friendly conversion path for legacy v1 vectors to avoid CPU fallback and numeric drift. Patch rolled out to us-east-1 on 2026-03-12 (PR #982). Customer reindexed the affected documents with --embed-version=v2 and observed rerank order restored to expected baseline. Monitoring for mixed-version traffic dropped to 0.0% and p95 latency returned to baseline within two hours.
